audit_findings.title: Forecast OE retains earnings from businesses already sold while the bridge adds their proceeds
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $298m gross cash proceeds, $272m net cash divestiture proceeds and $56m pre-tax gains; duplicated recurring earnings unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: FY2026 OE and its trend may include pre-sale earnings or disposal gains while the equity bridge adds year-end cash that may contain sale proceeds.
audit_findings.evidence: In fiscal year 2026, we sold four businesses identified as part of the strategic review for cash proceeds of $298 million, excluding deferred consideration.
audit_findings.explanation: The completed sales and FY2026 inclusion through their respective sale dates are demonstrated. The record does not identify the businesses' recurring OE, show whether disposal gains were removed, or establish how much of year-end cash represents retained proceeds; the claimed double count therefore remains an unresolved possibility whose materiality cannot be quantified.
audit_findings.action: Obtain business-level earnings through each disposal date and the FY2026 OE reconciliation; remove disposal gains and divested recurring earnings from the anchor, trace proceeds through debt repayment and cash, and rerun the scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The trend anchor spans fundamentally different pre- and post-Berry perimeters
audit_findings.magnitude: computed $125.7m anchor-to-FY2026 OE difference, equal to 9.4% of FY2026 OE; holding other inputs constant, $3.13-$4.12 per share of scenario sensitivity
audit_findings.mechanism: The mixed-perimeter log trend directly determines anchor OE and therefore every forecast year and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: On April 30, 2025, the Company completed its acquisition (the "Merger") of Berry Global Group, Inc ("Berry").
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated methodological error: FY2019-FY2024 exclude Berry, FY2025 includes only two months, and FY2026 includes a full year. The $125.7m difference between the selected anchor and current-perimeter FY2026 OE is sufficient to move the bull value from $42.24 to approximately $46.36 if the latest OE alone were substituted, which crosses the $45.15 market price. The proper normalized anchor could be higher or lower, so direction remains unknown.
audit_findings.action: Rebuild comparable pro forma combined-company OE for the historical periods or use a documented post-merger run rate, separately adjusting divestitures, realized synergies, remaining costs to achieve and nonrecurring items; rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: Merger integration cash costs may have been stripped before they cease
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $245m estimated net cash expenditures; at most $0.51 per share undiscounted, or 1.2%-1.6% of scenario equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Any cash integration expenditures added back to normalized OE must instead be deducted as finite forecast-period cash outflows until completion.
audit_findings.evidence: The Company estimates that restructuring and general integration activities initiated to date will result in net cash expenditures of approximately $245 million.
audit_findings.explanation: Whether the OE reconciliation improperly removed these costs is unresolved, but even treating the entire filed $245m estimate as an omitted incremental outflow would reduce value by no more than $0.51 per share before discounting and tax effects. That is well below the $2.91 gap between the $42.24 bull value and the $45.15 price and cannot reverse the present conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Inspect the FY2026 OE reconciliation, identify cash restructuring and integration amounts added back, and insert only unpaid cash costs through June 2028 as explicit forecast-period deductions without removing recurring synergy savings.

audit_findings.title: Pension funding claims are absent from the equity bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $243m net deficit and $65.1m next-12-month contributions; $0.51 and $0.14 per share, respectively
audit_findings.mechanism: An unfunded pension claim belongs either in the equity bridge or as excess cash contributions deducted from forecast OE, but not both.
audit_findings.evidence: Contributions to the Company's defined benefit pension plans, not including unfunded plans, are expected to be $ 65.1 million during the next 12 months.
audit_findings.explanation: The bridge omission is demonstrated, although normalized OE may already capture part of the economic cost. Deducting the entire $243m funded-status deficit would reduce value by $0.51 per share, only 1.2%-1.6% of scenario equity value and well below the $2.91 price-to-bull gap; it would reinforce rather than change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile pension service cost, net periodic expense, employer contributions and unfunded benefit payments in OE; if excess funding is not forecast, deduct the after-tax deficit once in the bridge and rerun.

audit_findings.title: FY2026 earnings benefited from a nonrecurring tax-rate reduction
audit_findings.magnitude: computed $85.9m annual tax difference between the filed 14.1% FY2026 and 20.8% FY2025 rates on $1,282m pretax income; $2.14-$2.82 per share of scenario sensitivity if recurring OE is overstated by that amount
audit_findings.mechanism: An unsustainably low cash tax rate overstates normalized OE, the trend anchor and the terminal-value earnings base.
audit_findings.evidence: The lower effective tax rate for fiscal year 2026 versus fiscal year 2025 is largely attributable to favorable return-to-provision adjustments recorded as current year discrete items identified upon completion of prior year income tax returns, movements in deferred tax positions including releases of valuation allowances, and changes in unrecognized tax benefits which are partially offset by non-deductible expenses related to the Merger.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates that discrete return-to-provision adjustments, valuation-allowance releases and changes in unrecognized tax benefits lowered FY2026 tax expense. It remains unresolved whether the OE reconciliation removed those benefits or what sustainable cash tax rate applies. The computed sensitivity approaches the $2.91 price-to-bull gap and is therefore reasonably capable of materially changing scenario values and the margin-of-safety assessment.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile FY2026 cash and book taxes by discrete item, remove nonrecurring benefits, establish a sustainable jurisdiction-weighted cash tax rate, recompute FY2026 OE and the comparable-perimeter anchor, and rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The bridge treats a seasonally high June cash balance as entirely excess
audit_findings.magnitude: filed $1,115m cash including $14m restricted cash; entire cash bridge equals $2.33 per share and restricted cash equals $0.03 per share
audit_findings.mechanism: Only cash exceeding restricted balances, seasonal working-capital needs and minimum operating liquidity should be added to equity value.
audit_findings.evidence: Historically, cash flow from operations has been lower in the six months ending December 31, and higher in the six months ending June 30, due to moderate seasonality, working capital requirements, and the timing of certain cash payments made in the six months ending December 31, including incentive compensation.
audit_findings.explanation: At least the $14m restricted portion is demonstrably not freely distributable; the additional operating-cash requirement is unquantified. Even removing the entire $1.115bn cash bridge would reduce the bull value from $42.24 to approximately $39.91, so this finding cannot reverse the conclusion that the $45.15 price exceeds every scenario value.
audit_findings.action: Determine restricted cash, minimum operating liquidity and the normal July-December cash draw from monthly balances and working-capital history; replace gross cash with demonstrably excess cash in the bridge.

audit_findings.title: Unidentified D&A is conservatively left in owner earnings
audit_findings.magnitude: computed historical residuals of $28.2m in FY2019, $44.4m in FY2020 and $64.0m in FY2022; current-anchor effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Eligible non-economic D&A left as an expense understates historical OE and may lower the fitted trend anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: identified eligible D&A is below the filed composite; residual is conservatively left as an expense, not added back: FY2019 $28.2m (6.2% of filed D&A); FY2020 $44.4m (6.8% of filed D&A); FY2022 $64.0m (10.2% of filed D&A)
audit_findings.explanation: The conservative treatment is demonstrated for the cited years, but the record does not classify the residual or provide corresponding amounts for the current Berry perimeter. Some portion could qualify for addition to OE, yet neither the current annual adjustment nor its effect on the trend can be established, so materiality remains uncertain.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the fixed-asset and intangible-amortization schedules underlying residual D&A, classify each component under the owner-earnings policy, and rerun the historical OE series and anchor only for amounts supported as eligible add-backs.
